messages:
Nate (AE): Heads-up  Orion Analytics CFO paused POC signoff. Three hard asks: 1) BYO KMS (keys never exported), 2) private egress to their gateway, 3) a short pilot latency commitment. Need a quick internal triage and exec bridge tomorrow morning.
Priya (SE): Ack. Clarify: live HSM peering (RPC) required or will a KMS-proxy (mTLS forwarding) be acceptable?
Nate (AE): They said live HSM preferred, but might accept proxy if crypto controls match.
Eli (Presales): Quick reality check: direct HSM RPC peering isn't standard. Short-term options: (A) KMS-proxy that routes signing to their HSM over mTLS, (B) cloud-KMS BYOK import with attestation. Both need security/legal signoff.
Sam (SRE): Perf note: target 600 qps, seq=64. Baseline internal: rw-v2-large seq64 p50~50ms p95~140ms. If HSM roundtrip is in-path expect tail increases. Recommend Dedicated pool + `--kv-cache` + aggressive batching and a warm canary.
Maggie (Security): Security items: HSM vendor FIPS cert, network diagram, MTLS cert exchange, attestation form. Live peering raises risk; will start a short threat summary.
Jon (Legal): Legal: we can draft a KMS addendum and a timeboxed pilot SLA with capped credits; live HSM peering will need a crypto addendum and liability carve-outs. Send procurement redlines.
ticket-bot: ticket SLS-50123 created: "Orion Analytics POC - KMS peering + private egress + pilot SLA" assigned to eng-oncall. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SLS-50123
Priya (SE): I'll prepare two diagrams (HSM peering vs KMS-proxy) and a one-page runbook for their network team.
Sam (SRE): I'll spin a staging cluster tonight and run a mocked-HSM smoke in the AM: `./smoke_test --model rw-v2-large --concurrency 600 --seq 64 --kv-cache --mock-hsm-latency=20ms`. Will post results.
Eli (Presales): Proposed bridge agenda: 1) recap (3m), 2) KMS options + tradeoffs (8m), 3) network peering steps (7m), 4) SLA & fallback modes (5m), 5) next steps (2m).
Nate (AE): Can the team join a bridge tomorrow 9:00am PT? CFO prefers morning.
Sam (SRE): 9:00am PT works. I'll bring perf numbers and fallback plan.
Maggie (Security): I'll join for attestation and risk summary.
Jon (Legal): Standby; will join if contractual language is requested.
Nate (AE): Owners: Priya -> diagrams & runbook; Sam -> perf tests & ops checklist; Eli -> bridge slides & timeline; Maggie -> attestation & risk note; Jon -> addendum draft. I'll coordinate calendar and customer comms.
Priya (SE): Note for slides: recommend `--kv-cache-enabled` and `--batch-policy=aggressive`.
Nate (AE): Thanks team. Customer priority is key control; show HSM path first and KMS-proxy as contingency.
